cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh.finding: Receivables factoring and supplier-finance programmes cannot be cleared: the record tags no proceeds from sale of receivables and no supplier-finance obligation, and the notes reader reports no such paragraph, so `terms.trailing_four_quarters.proceeds_from_sale_of_receivables` and `terms.balances_now.supplier_finance_obligation` are not there. Unconditional purchase obligations and guarantee maximum exposure are likewise untagged, and the operating lease liability is stated only at year-end ({ratios.solvency.operating_lease_liability.value}), not at the quarter. What the record does show is, first, a free-cash-flow measure that the release defines as starting from continuing operating cash but reconciles from the total operating line, which includes discontinued operating cash; the numbers reader confirms the two lines differ, so reported free cash flow is larger than its own definition allows, and the discontinued portion has no calculator field to size an adjustment. Second, the six-month rise in continuing operating cash is carried by accounts payable and accrued liabilities, whose contribution is far above the prior year, and by 'other operating activities, net', which swung from near nothing to a material inflow; year over year payables are flat ({earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.balance_sheet_change.value}), so this is a within-year build. Third, distributions from equity-method investments in the quarter were many times the prior-year quarter's while equity earnings fell. Fourth, short-term borrowings of {terms.cash_flow_families.borrowing_short_term_net.cash_effect} over the trailing four quarters funded repurchases of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_repurchases.value} and dividends of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.dividends_paid.value}; net debt is {ratios.solvency.net_debt.value} and debt over EBITDA {ratios.solvency.debt_over_ebitda.value}. Fifth, the held-for-sale table shows debt rows inside the disposal group with no prose saying which group or what debt, and cash inside the group rose. Sixth, the AFFF settlement commits cash over five years while the estimated insurance recoveries tagged in the filing are not recorded as proceeds and the remaining claims are called not estimable. Dividends to non-controlling interests jumped. No variable-interest entity disclosure appears in the record. Share-based compensation of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation.value} is already subtracted in free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted, which stands at {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted.value} against simple free cash flow of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple.value}.
cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh.verdict: questionable: the headline free-cash-flow measure exceeds its own definition, the operating-cash improvement is payables- and other-driven, and factoring or supplier finance cannot be ruled out from the record

cross_document_reconciliation.finding: The 8-K earnings release and the 10-Q agree on every headline figure the numbers reader compared: net sales, operating profit, net income attributable, effective tax rate, receivables and inventories. Of the notes items carrying a direction, most are confirmed by the filed numbers (Riello impairment and its tax effect, Noresco held-for-sale balances, commercial-paper interest, repurchases and treasury stock, short-term borrowings, the quarter's tax-rate rise, the Swiss release and state settlement, organic growth, restructuring in cost of sales and SG&A, Europe, Asia and Transportation segment pressure, joint-venture earnings, continuing operating cash); none is contradicted outright; the forward-looking ones (held-for-sale run-off, restructuring accrual usage, delivery timing, orders and backlog, guidance headwinds, 'better than expected') and the unquantified bridge items (Americas 'timing and classification', Europe legal reserve, Asia land-sale gain) are unresolved because no filed fact reaches them. The disagreements are between documents rather than with the numbers: the release's free cash flow starts from a line its own definition excludes; the MD&A says the Europe segment 'recorded' the Riello impairment while every reconciliation places it outside segment profit, and Europe segment profit confirms it is outside; the equity note's repurchase purchase price differs from the cash-flow statement's repurchase line; the release and the 10-Q give different percentages for the Americas commercial decline and different primary drivers (price versus volume) for Americas growth; the release calls Europe price/cost favourable where the 10-Q cites price promotions; the release names the Middle East conflict and omits the land-sale gain that the 10-Q puts inside Asia segment profit; and the release's reconciliation drops the tax-specific adjustment line it carried a year earlier.
cross_document_reconciliation.verdict: release and filing agree on the numbers; the conflicts are in the explanations, of which the free-cash-flow definition, the Riello segment attribution and the repurchase figure are outright inconsistencies

reconciliation.why: The run-off is expected next quarter; at the balance-sheet date held-for-sale assets rose, because Noresco was added, and the record does not reach the post-closing quarter.
The impairment fact and its non-deductible tax reconciliation item both carry the stated amount for the quarter; the consideration fact is unchanged.
Held-for-sale assets, liabilities, goodwill and cash all rose from year-end, consistent with a second disposal group being added.
Held-for-sale liabilities rose, but no fact identifies which disposal group holds the debt rows or what kind of debt it is.
No fact isolates the transition-tax liability; accrued liabilities as a whole rose from year-end, so the settlement cannot be seen in the numbers.
The tagged reserve matches the prose at both dates; the numbers add that the reserve fell while net inventory rose, which the prose does not say.
The commercial-paper fact matches the note, and current debt rose sharply from year-end.
Net non-operating interest expense worsened against the prior-year quarter while short-term borrowings rose and commercial paper remained outstanding.
Project-financing issuance and repayment are not tagged separately from total long-term debt movements.
Treasury stock rose, the remaining authorization matches, and the weighted share count fell; the cash-flow repurchase amount is slightly below the note's purchase price.
No issued or treasury share-count fact is itemised; the weighted-average count fell, which is consistent but not the same figure.
The filed cash-flow fact is the lower of the two figures, so the gap between the equity note's purchase price and the cash paid is real and unexplained.
The net short-term borrowing fact matches and current debt rose from year-end while repurchases and dividends were paid.
The August payment falls after the period; the six-month dividends paid appear in the calculator but the declared amount is not yet a filed flow.
No fact tags revenue recognized from opening contract liabilities; the balance itself rose from year-end, so new deferrals exceeded recognition.

The reserve rose against both prior dates because new charges outran usage; the claim that most of it will be used within twelve months is forward and untested, and the large translation-and-other outflow is unexplained.
The quarter's effective rate and tax expense rose and the non-deductible impairment reconciliation item matches; the German-rate effect is not separately tagged.
Both reconciliation items are tagged at the stated amounts, the six-month rate fell to under half the prior year's, and the first-quarter rate was negative.
The adjusted six-month rate sits above the reported rate, so some tax effect was removed, but no fact shows whether the Swiss release and the settlement stayed inside adjusted earnings.
The tagged range matches the note; whether the decrease occurs is a future event.
Expected closure dates have no filed number to test.
No AFFF accrual at the quarter end is among the quotable facts; only earlier accrual figures are repeated.
Court approval is a future step; the estimated insurance recoveries are tagged but no proceeds are recorded.
No refund is recorded and no fact sizes the tariffs paid; the margin items only confirm tariffs are a stated headwind.
Quarterly revenue rose against the prior-year quarter in every region; the volume-versus-price split is not a filed fact.
Gross margin itself cannot be computed from the record, but operating profit fell on higher revenue and Americas segment cost of sales rose faster than segment revenue.
Consolidated SG&A is not itemised; segment SG&A rose while corporate and other fell, which is consistent with a flat total but does not prove it.
Equity-method earnings fell in total and in both the Americas and Asia segments.
Restructuring charged to cost of goods and services sold rose several-fold against the prior-year six months.
Six-month segment SG&A rose and the SG&A portion of restructuring rose against a year earlier.
Americas segment revenue rose in both periods, but the residential and commercial split the two paragraphs disagree about is not a filed fact.
Rising contract liabilities are consistent with deliveries deferred against prepayment, but the claim is about next quarter and the record does not reach it.
The commercial sub-line is not a filed fact, so the numbers cannot arbitrate between the two documents' percentages.
Segment revenue rose and margin fell, but no fact splits price from volume.
Americas segment profit fell in both periods; the positive 'Other' component has no dollar amount and cannot be isolated.
Europe revenue rose while segment profit fell in the quarter and the six months.
No fact separates price from cost inflation and productivity, so the numbers cannot say which document is right.
No amount is stated and no fact tags the release; six-month Europe segment profit fell despite it.
The consolidated accrual rose against every prior date and the annual ratio is at a five-year high, although the pre-existing-warranty estimate change was a release this year.
Segment profit fell while regional revenue rose, matching the account that the rest of the region offset China; China itself is not tagged.
The gain has no amount and no tag; segment profit fell despite it and consolidated other operating income swung negative.
Asia segment equity-method earnings fell in the quarter and the six months; the cause is not a filed fact.
Transportation segment profit fell in both periods.

Continuing operating cash rose while net income fell, and the working-capital lines moved favourably, chiefly payables and accrued liabilities; total operating cash nonetheless fell on discontinued operations.
Six-month capital expenditure in the release's reconciliation matches the MD&A figure and is above a year earlier.
The cash balance in the net-debt table matches the MD&A's rounded figure; the foreign share is not tagged.
Interest expense is not tagged for the period, so the expected annual payment cannot be tested.
No expectation figure is in the input; GAAP and adjusted EPS both fell against the prior-year quarter.
Orders have no filed fact; rising contract liabilities are consistent but the claim is about future revenue.
Forward guidance; six-month free cash flow as the release reconciles it is below a year earlier.
The headwinds are twelve-month guidance; the numbers confirm only that both businesses are held for sale.
The EPS effect is forward; capital expenditure rising against a year earlier is consistent with factory spending but the factory is not described anywhere in the filing.

The numbers reader verified that the reconciliation starts from the total operating line and that continuing and total differ by the discontinued cash, so the reported measure contradicts its stated definition.
A disclosure gap in the MD&A has no number to test; the held-for-sale balances confirm the agreement's accounting effect.

anomalies.name: Riello revenue-headwind estimate restated in guidance
anomalies.name_ko: 가이던스의 Riello 매출 감소 추정치 수정
anomalies.what: The release lowered its Riello headwind estimate and added a NORESCO one; guidance, not financials, but a quiet revision of a prior-period figure.

anomalies.name: Release and 10-Q agree on headline figures
anomalies.name_ko: 실적발표와 10-Q의 주요 수치 일치
anomalies.what: Net sales, operating profit, net income attributable, effective tax rate, receivables and inventories match between the 8-K and the 10-Q facts; clean.

anomalies.name: MD&A says Europe segment recorded the impairment; reconciliations exclude it from segment profit
anomalies.name_ko: MD&A는 유럽 부문 손상 인식이라 하나 부문이익 조정표는 제외
anomalies.what: The MD&A states the Climate Solutions Europe segment recorded the Riello impairment, while every reconciliation shows it as a separate row outside segment operating profit; Europe segment profit fell only slightly, which confirms the charge is outside.

anomalies.name: Equity note purchase price differs from cash-flow repurchase line
anomalies.name_ko: 자본 주석의 매입가액과 현금흐름표 자사주 매입액 불일치
anomalies.what: The equity note's aggregate purchase price for six-month repurchases exceeds the cash-flow statement's repurchase line, which the MD&A cash-flow prose uses; no text explains the difference. A benign reading is trade-date versus settlement or excise-tax accrual, but the filing does not say.

anomalies.name: Release reconciliation drops the tax-specific adjustment line
anomalies.name_ko: 실적발표 조정표에서 세금 특정 조정 항목 삭제
anomalies.what: The prior-year reconciliation carried 'Tax specific adjustments'; this year's carries only 'Tax effect on adjustments above', so the Swiss release and state settlement appear to remain inside adjusted EPS and the adjusted six-month tax rate.

anomalies.name: Release calls Europe price/cost favourable; 10-Q cites price promotions
anomalies.name_ko: 유럽 가격/원가: 실적발표는 유리, 10-Q는 판촉 부담
anomalies.what: The release's price/cost definition folds cost inflation and productivity into pricing, which may reconcile the two, but the documents leave opposite impressions of European pricing.

anomalies.name: MD&A calls Americas demand both improved and reduced
anomalies.name_ko: MD&A 내 미주 수요를 '개선'과 '감소'로 상반 서술
anomalies.what: The consolidated paragraph credits improved Americas end-market demand while the segment paragraph attributes flat residential and lower commercial results to reduced demand; commercial gets different causes for the quarter and the six months.

anomalies.name: Land-sale gain only in the 10-Q; Middle East conflict only in the release
anomalies.name_ko: 토지 매각이익은 10-Q에만, 중동 분쟁은 실적발표에만 언급
anomalies.what: The 10-Q puts a land-sale gain inside Asia segment profit that the release does not mention; the release attributes lower JV income to the Middle East conflict, which the 10-Q does not name. Neither has a dollar amount.

anomalies.name: Inventory builds within the year while the reserve falls
anomalies.name_ko: 연중 재고 증가 속 충당금 감소
anomalies.what: Inventory rose from year-end to {terms.balances_now.inventory.value} while the reserve fell to {terms.balances_now.inventory_reserve.value}; ratio {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.inventory_reserve_ratio.value}, above the year-ago {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.inventory_reserve_ratio.value}; days sales of inventory cannot be computed because cost of revenue is not tagged.

anomalies.name: Company invests in joint ventures that are also its customers
anomalies.name_ko: 고객이기도 한 합작투자사에 지분 투자
anomalies.what: Related-party product revenue flows to equity-method joint ventures the company partly owns; equity-method earnings fell while quarterly distributions rose sharply, and an equity-method investment was disposed of at a loss. Circular by structure; no prose addresses the receivable build.

anomalies.name: No customer concentration facts in the filing
anomalies.name_ko: 고객 집중도 관련 공시 사실 없음
anomalies.what: concentration.facts is empty; the filing states no customer share, so concentration cannot be assessed beyond the related-party channel.

anomalies.name: Purchase commitments not disclosed in the record
anomalies.name_ko: 구매약정 공시 기록 없음
anomalies.what: No purchase-obligation concept is tagged and no notes paragraph on commitments in excess of need exists, so this cannot be cleared.

anomalies.name: Project-financing vendor debt sits in a business being sold
anomalies.name_ko: 매각 예정 사업의 프로젝트 파이낸싱 차입
anomalies.what: Project financing debt was issued and repaid in the six months; the energy-services business that carries it is held for sale, and the debt rows now inside the held-for-sale table are unexplained.

summary_ko.earnings_versus_cash: 최근 사분기 누적 영업현금흐름 대비 순이익 비율은 {earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income.value}, 발생액 비율은 {earnings_versus_cash.accruals_over_average_assets.value}로 현금이 이익을 웃돌지만, 반기 영업현금 개선은 이익이 아니라 매입채무·미지급비용과 기타 항목에서 나왔다. 매출채권과 재고의 재무상태표 변동과 현금흐름표 변동 사이에 각각 {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.articulation_gap.value}, {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.articulation_gap.value}의 설명되지 않은 차이가 있다.
summary_ko.revenue_recognition: 분기 매출채권회전일수는 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding.value}일로 최근 일곱 분기 중 두 번째로 낮고 계약부채 비율은 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue.value}로 높아 매출 선인식 징후는 없다. 다만 특수관계자 매출채권이 연초 대비 거의 두 배로 늘었고, 미주 상업용 매출 감소율과 성장 요인을 실적발표와 10-Q가 다르게 설명한다.
summary_ko.estimates_and_reserves: 대손충당금 비율 {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio.value}는 오년래 최저이고, 보증 추정치와 유럽 법률 충당금이 환입됐으며, 스위스 자회사 평가충당금 환입으로 최근 사분기 유효세율이 {tax_rate.value|pct}까지 낮아졌는데 이 이익이 조정이익에 남아 있다. Riello 손상과 구조조정 충당부채의 기타 조정은 설명이 없다.
summary_ko.cost_deferral: 자본화 징후는 기록에 없으나, '비경상' 구조조정비용이 매 기간 반복되고 조정이익과 GAAP 이익의 격차가 커졌다. 연성자산 비중은 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share.value}로 사상 최고이고 연구개발비는 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.research_and_development_expense.value}로 감소했다.
summary_ko.cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh: 실적발표의 잉여현금흐름은 정의와 달리 중단영업 현금을 포함해 계산됐고, 영업현금 개선은 매입채무·미지급비용 증가와 기타 항목에 기댔다. 매출채권 매각·공급망금융·구매약정·보증은 기록에 없어 확인할 수 없으며, 단기차입 {terms.cash_flow_families.borrowing_short_term_net.cash_effect}로 자사주 매입 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_repurchases.value}을 조달했다.
summary_ko.controls_audit_and_filing_signals: 내부통제 결론과 제출 시기에는 문제가 없다. 다만 10-Q 직전 임원 변동 8-K의 본문을 볼 수 없고, 특수관계자 거래가 늘었으며, MD&A 본문이 Noresco 매각을 전혀 언급하지 않는다.
summary_ko.cross_document_reconciliation: 8-K와 10-Q의 주요 수치는 일치한다. 그러나 잉여현금흐름 정의와 계산 출발선, Riello 손상의 부문 귀속, 자사주 매입금액, 미주 상업용 매출 감소율과 성장 요인, 유럽 가격 설명에서 문서 간 서술이 어긋난다.
summary_ko.industry_lens: 재고는 {terms.balances_now.inventory.value}로 늘었는데 충당금은 {terms.balances_now.inventory_reserve.value}로 줄었고, 재고회전일수는 원가 태그가 없어 계산할 수 없다. 고객 집중도와 구매약정은 공시가 없으며, 고객이기도 한 합작투자사에 투자하는 구조와 특수관계자 매출채권 증가가 순환거래 위험의 핵심이다.

limits: This analysis finds where the numbers and the explanations disagree, and where the company differs from its own past. It does not judge intent, and it cannot see evidence outside the filings, such as invoices or contracts.
